def get_nowait(self) ->_T:
        """Remove and return an item from the queue without blocking.

        Return an item if one is immediately available, else raise
        `QueueEmpty`.
        """
        self._consume_expired()
        if self.empty():
            raise QueueEmpty
    
        item = self._get()
    
        # If we have putters waiting and we're at max capacity
        # we can now accept a new item from a waiting putter
        if self._putters and (self.maxsize == 0 or self.qsize() < self.maxsize):
            new_item, putter = self._putters.popleft()
            self.__put_internal(new_item)
            future_set_result_unless_cancelled(putter, None)
    
        return item
